son of Ahab, one year;

[Jehoram his son {OCR?}] eight years.
This man took Athaliah, the sister of Ahab, as his wife,
and killed all his brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat.
Therefore, he was struck by the rod of righteousness,

after [him, Ahaziah his son {OCR?}], one year.
And in it, Elisha the prophet sent
and anointed Jehu the son of Nimshi over Israel.
And he reigned twenty-eight years,
and killed the seventy sons of Ahab and the pagan priests,
and destroyed the temple of Baal.
Now after Elisha anointed Jehu the son of Nimshi,
he (Jehu?) killed Jehoram the son of Ahab,
and Ahaziah king of Judah,
and Jezebel the Sidonian, the wife of Ahab.
After him, Athaliah {OCR?}, seven years.
When her son Ahaziah was killed,
she destroyed all the royal seed.
And none escaped except Joash the son of Ahaziah,
whom Jehosheba, the sister of Ahaziah, hid;
she was the wife of Jehoiada the chief priest.
And this Jehoiada assembled Judah and killed Athaliah,
and made Joash king at the age of seven years.
And he sent the Jews again to the house of Baal,
and burned Mattan the priest.
After [him], Joash [son of Ahaziah {OCR?}] his son, forty years.
And in the twenty-fifth year of Joash, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu reigned over Israel seventeen years.
And in the thirty-sixth year of Joash, Elisha the prophet died.
And afterward, Joash was killed by his servants.
[Amaziah his son {OCR?}], twenty-nine years.
This man conquered Edom and Seir (and Samaria {OCR?}),
and brought their gods to Jerusalem,
and worshipped them.
And in the tenth year of Amaziah, Joash reigned over Israel sixteen years.
And he went out to battle against Ben-Hadad, king of Syria,
and recovered the cities that Hazael had taken.
And he struck the Edomites three times,
according to the word of the Lord to Elisha.
And at that time, Hosea, Amos, Nahum, and Jonathan (Jonah?) were prophesying.
And in the eighteenth year of Amaziah, Jeroboam reigned over Israel forty years.
And Amaziah king of Judah contended with Joash king of Israel,
and the children of Israel went up against Judah,
and destroyed of them three hundred men.
And Amaziah was pierced with a spear and died.
